Mega Man X4 - No Music
======================

Optional audio mod, disabled by default. Silences XA/BGM1_U.XA, BGM2.XA,
BGM3.XA, BGM4.XA and BGM5_U.XA with disc_raw overlays. These are the only
music streams referenced by the executable, so title, menu, stage and boss
music are muted.

Voices (XA/VOICE*), boss intros (XA/BOSINT), cutscene audio (STR/*.STR) and
SPU sound effects are unchanged. The stock BIN/CUE is not modified.

Music-free play for players who prefer no music. I'm a Muslim and prefer to
play without music.

Enable "Mute All Music (Menus + Gameplay)" on the Mods page and boot fresh.

Author: Yossef Khalil (https://github.com/YossefKhalil)
Built with OpenCode (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash).
License: MIT
